# Altitude Design System

> 67 Lit 3 web components with React 19 wrappers, 607 design
> tokens across three tiers, and 2 brands driven off one library. Published as
> `@southleft/al-web-components` and `@southleft/al-react`.

GENERATED by `scripts/build-root-llms.mjs` from the committed artifacts named
below. Do not edit this file by hand — every count and every tag in it is read,
and `node scripts/build-root-llms.mjs --check` fails when it drifts.

## Read these before generating code

The full machine documentation lives on the docs site, one subject per file, and
is regenerated from the library on every build.

- [https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms.txt](https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms.txt): the map — rules, counts, component index.
- [https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-tokens.txt](https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-tokens.txt): all 607 tokens with resolved values. **The set is closed.**
- [https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-components.txt](https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-components.txt): every element's complete API — attributes, slots, events, CSS parts, methods.
- [https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-a11y.txt](https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-a11y.txt): what was machine-measured, and what was never recorded.
- [https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-full.txt](https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-full.txt): all of the above concatenated.

Every documentation page is also served as Markdown at the same URL plus `.md`.

## Rules

You MUST follow these. Each names a failure mode observed in generated code.

1. You must ONLY use the tokens listed in https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-tokens.txt. Do not make up
   values. A raw hex, px length or font stack in a rule a token covers is wrong
   even when it renders identically — it will not follow a brand, mode, density
   or contrast setting.
2. You must ONLY use CSS custom property names from that file. An unknown
   `--al-*` name is not an error; CSS falls back silently, so an invented token
   ships a page that renders and is wrong. There are 607 real ones in
   226 families.
3. You must not invent an element, attribute, slot or event. The manifest is the
   whole set.
4. You must render components inside `<al-theme brand="…">`. Tokens are set on
   that host, not on `:root`.
5. You must arrange sibling components with `<al-layout>` and its props — not
   hand-rolled flex or grid, and not a new `*-group` wrapper. The groups that
   exist do so for their SEMANTICS (fieldset/legend, roving keyboard selection,
   single-select state), not their spacing.
6. You must pick ONE registration path per document. See the registration model
   below.

### Token names that do not exist — do not write these

From `.altitude/ai-readiness/tokens-digest.json`; each has been observed being
invented because it looks like it should exist.

- `--al-theme-focus-ring-*`
- `--al-theme-transition-duration-* (use --al-animation-duration-*)`
- `--al-theme-color-content-neutral-bold`
- `--al-theme-color-content-default-weaker`

## Install

```sh
npm install @southleft/al-web-components
npm install @southleft/al-react
```

- Web components: `@southleft/al-web-components` (workspace `libs/al-web-components`), v2.0.0
- React 19 wrappers: `@southleft/al-react` (workspace `libs/al-react`), v2.0.0

```html
<script>window.alAutoRegistry = true;</script>
<script type="module">
  import '@southleft/al-web-components/components/button';
</script>

<al-theme brand="altitude">
  <al-button>Continue</al-button>
</al-theme>
```

## Registration — three paths, never mixed in one document

- [The complete model](/.altitude/REGISTRATION.md): which path to take and why the flag is load-bearing

- **Template frameworks and plain HTML** — set `window.alAutoRegistry = true`
  inline in `<head>`, before any module script. ESM imports hoist, so setting it
  from application JS is too late.
- **React** — import the wrappers from `@southleft/al-react`; set no flag. Each wrapper
  registers its element with a version suffix.
- **Micro-frontends** — set no flag and call
  `registerAltitude({ mode: 'versioned', suffix })` for coexisting versions.

## Components (67)

Each has a page at `https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/components/<name>` and a Markdown twin at the same
URL plus `.md`.

`al-accordion`, `al-accordion-panel`, `al-alert`, `al-avatar`, `al-badge`, `al-banner`, `al-breadcrumbs`, `al-breadcrumbs-item`, `al-button`, `al-calendar`, `al-card`, `al-checkbox`, `al-checkbox-group`, `al-chip`, `al-combobox`, `al-command-palette`, `al-date-picker`, `al-date-time-picker`, `al-dialog`, `al-divider`, `al-drawer`, `al-dropdown-panel`, `al-empty-state`, `al-field-note`, `al-file-upload`, `al-focus-trap`, `al-footer`, `al-header`, `al-heading`, `al-icon`, `al-input`, `al-input-stepper`, `al-layout`, `al-link`, `al-list`, `al-list-item`, `al-logo`, `al-menu`, `al-menu-item`, `al-pagination`, `al-pagination-item`, `al-popover`, `al-progress`, `al-radio`, `al-radio-group`, `al-range`, `al-search`, `al-select`, `al-skeleton`, `al-spinner`, `al-stat`, `al-stepper`, `al-stepper-item`, `al-tab`, `al-tab-panel`, `al-table`, `al-tabs`, `al-testimonial`, `al-text-block`, `al-textarea`, `al-theme`, `al-theme-switcher`, `al-time-selector-list`, `al-toast`, `al-toggle`, `al-toggle-button`, `al-tooltip`

Plus 37 icon glyph elements, which are payloads of `<al-icon>` rather than
components with an API of their own.

## Tokens (607)

- Prefix: `--al-`.
- Semantic layer: --al-theme-* (single layer of indirection over the --al-color-* / --al-font-size-* primitives).
- Primitive layer: --al-animation-*, --al-border-*, --al-box-*, --al-breakpoint-*, --al-color-*, --al-font-*, --al-letter-*, --al-line-*, --al-opacity-*, --al-text-*, --al-typography-*, --al-z-*.
- Font sizes: numeric — --al-font-size-{10,12,14,16,20,24,28,32,36,48,56,64,72,112} (14 stops; NOT t-shirt sizes like -sm/-md/-lg/-2xl).
- Font weights: --al-font-weight-{bold,medium,regular,semibold} ONLY (no -thin, -extralight, -light, -extrabold, -heavy, -black).
- The colour families are NOT free-form: each role has a fixed suffix set, listed
  in the digest and rendered in full at https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/llms-tokens.txt.

## Accessibility

axe-core 4.12.1 against a static Storybook build, story by story:
500 stories, 67 components measured, 0 structural violations,
16 contrast violations (`color-contrast` is reported but not gated).
Screen-reader and keyboard rows need a human and read NOT RECORDED until one runs
them — a missing result is never a pass.

- [The report](/.altitude/a11y/report.json): per-story axe results
- [Manual test records](/.altitude/a11y/manual-tests.json): the screen-reader and keyboard passes a human actually ran

## Source of truth — all of it tracked in git

Readable in a bare clone with no build. Every link in this section is asserted to
exist and to be tracked before this file is written.

- [Custom Elements Manifest](/libs/al-web-components/custom-elements.json): every element, generated by @custom-elements-manifest/analyzer; coverage gated by `scripts/check-cem-coverage.js`
- [CEM digest](/.altitude/ai-readiness/cem-digest.json): the same graph flattened per tag — attributes, slots, events, enum values, plus a `doNotFlag` array of sanctioned patterns a reviewer must not report as violations
- [Tokens digest](/.altitude/ai-readiness/tokens-digest.json): all 607 names grouped into 226 families, with the role/suffix matrix and the do-not-invent list
- [Token source](/libs/al-web-components/styles/tokens-dtcg): the hand-authored DTCG tree everything else is built from; each token carries a standard `$type` plus an `org.altitude.token.cssType` extension naming the CSS surface it is authored for
- [Design-system registry](/.altitude/ds-projects.json): the 2 systems this one library drives (altitude, southleft), each with its own Figma file, brand and documented scope

### Built artifacts — import them, do not link them

These are emitted by `pnpm --filter @southleft/al-web-components build` and are NOT tracked in
git, so they have no repository path a fresh clone could follow. They ship in the
published package, and that is how to reach them:

```js
import tokens from '@southleft/al-web-components/tokens.json';     // every resolved --al-* value
import aliases from '@southleft/al-web-components/aliases.json';   // the frozen alias map
```
```ts
import type {} from '@southleft/al-web-components/tokens.d.ts';    // the token-name union
```

`@southleft/al-web-components/tokens-dtcg/*` exports the token source itself: `styles/tokens-dtcg/`
is tracked, hand-authored DTCG and ships in the package. Each token carries the
standard `$type` plus an `org.altitude.token.cssType` extension naming the CSS
surface it was authored for — `$type` alone is coarser than the token's intent.

The committed digests above carry the same NAMES, which is what an agent needs;
the values live in the package.

## MCP server — 9 tools

- [libs/altitude-mcp](/libs/altitude-mcp/README.md): a read-only stdio + streamable-HTTP MCP server over exactly the artifacts above; registered in `.mcp.json` as `altitude`

- `altitude_list_components`
- `altitude_get_component`
- `altitude_validate`
- `altitude_get_tokens`
- `altitude_resolve_token`
- `altitude_search_icons`
- `altitude_generate_theme`
- `altitude_check_parity`
- `altitude_list_ds_projects`

HTTP mode binds loopback only, reflects CORS to loopback origins only, and
rejects a non-loopback `Host` — it reads the working tree and has no auth.
Every tool is covered by `libs/altitude-mcp/test/smoke.mjs`, which asserts the
count so a new tool cannot ship untested.

## Contributing to Altitude

Everything below is for people changing the library, not for people using it.

- [Agent contract](/AGENTS.md): authoring rules, guardrails G1–G8, where things live, how to verify a change
- [Contributor guide](/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, workspaces, the gate list
- [Refactor plan](/.altitude/history/NEXT-GEN-UPGRADE-PLAN.md): the v2 phases P0–P6 and their tasks
- [v1 → v2 migration](/MIGRATION.md): what moved, and the scoped-theming migration
- [Migration manifest](/.altitude/migration.json): per-component state; `legacy` components are read-only outside migration PRs (G2, CI-enforced)
- [Pinned targets](/.altitude/targets.json): committed end-state versions
- [Subsystem docs](/.altitude/README.md): tokens, build, semver, brands, SSR, parity, registration
- [Baselines](/.altitude/baselines/README.md): VRT screenshots, token snapshot, bundle size — the truth-set every change must move with (G8)
